The annual Conservative Political Action Conference is attended by leading Republican politicians as well as gun activists, anti-abortion campaigners and evangelical Christians. Nigel Farage, who has developed a cult following in the States after regular TV appearances on Fox News, will address the annual Conservative Political Action Conference tonight . Visitors to the summit are sometimes handed plastic foetuses by activists to show their opposition to abortion.
